metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for terminal titles, uncertainty detection, session housekeeping, agent resume guards, and child session spawning.

plugins.name: terminal-title
plugins.description: Sets the terminal tab title to reflect current Claude Code activity.

plugins.name: stop-reminders
plugins.description: Detects uncertain language in Claude's responses and reminds it to investigate before guessing.

plugins.name: session-start-housekeeping
plugins.description: Creates temp directories, cleans stale dist artifacts, and removes ephemeral config files on session start.

plugins.name: guardrail
plugins.description: Blocks general-purpose Agent calls (redirecting to spawn-claude) and Agent resume calls (preventing polling loops).

plugins.name: bash-output-filter
plugins.description: Strips wasteful patterns from Bash tool output (git boilerplate, long lines, repeated diagnostics) to save tokens.

plugins.name: claude-spawn
plugins.description: Spawns steerable child Claude Code sessions in terminal windows with automatic result forwarding via hooks. Requires the spawn-claude CLI to be on PATH.
